notes: XPath is supported as a typed value, Locator.xpath(expression), rather than an xpath= or // string prefix: element nodes in document order; chained, a / that begins the first step, after optional whitespace, is read from each match, as Playwright does, while a bare /, alone or before |, is left as written; only the very start is rewritten, so a union's later branch and (//a)[1] stay document-relative (.//a | .//b keeps both inside); InvalidInput at once for a malformed, prefixed or non-node-set expression. text=, >> and custom selector engines are excluded for 1.0. :has-text() and the other Playwright pseudo-classes have no exclusion decision; filter({ hasText }) and getByText cover their text matching. The combined gap stays missing until every remaining form is built or excluded.
